438:t_002:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Are those $$インベーダー#pilot$$ reinforcements!?」

438:t_003:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Looks like it's only the Solar System-limited kind.」

438:t_003:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Doesn't matter. If they're $$宇宙怪獣$$, I just have to crush them.」

438:t_003:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$, I request a tactical decision.」

438:t_003:5.en:
$$レド$$
「...Maybe even those space monsters have no real reason to fight.」

438:t_003:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The intent of your statement is incomprehensible. I request instructions again.」

438:t_003:9.en:
$$レド$$
(The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ turned out to be humans who had artificially evolved themselves...)

438:t_003:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Will a day come when I reveal this fact to everyone...)

438:t_003:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There are not many $$宇宙怪獣$$. All units, intercept them.」

438:t_003:13.en:
$$宗介$$
($$テッサ$$ has shaken off her despair and is trying to fight. Then so will I...!)

438:t_005:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Now it's an army of mystery robots!」

438:t_005:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「So those guys are different from $$ズール$$'s forces?」

438:t_005:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. Their true identity is still unknown even now.」

438:t_005:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Either way they're enemies, so we just have to beat them!」

438:t_005:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「But at this rate, it's going to turn into a melee...!」

438:t_005:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Then we just take them down one after another!」

438:t_005:7.en:
$$チコ$$
「Our princess can't let herself be outdone, either.」

438:t_005:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I don't need to be told...! I have no intention of going down before I reach $$蒼の地球$$!」

438:t_005:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「Let's go, everybody! These guys don't even know how to say hello. No need to hold back!!」

438:t_006:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Looks like the main event has arrived!」

438:t_007:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Such a forgetful brat. I'm $$アムブリエル$$ now.」

438:t_007:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Slipping in under cover of the chaos to do away with us... That's a petty trick, and hardly what I'd expect of a lady.」

438:t_007:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You dream too much about women. Or are you projecting your own ideal onto $$西条涼音$$ too?」

438:t_007:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You men do love them, don't you? Female teachers and nurses.」

438:t_007:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I won't deny it, but I didn't want to hear that from Miss $$スズネ$$'s own mouth!」

438:t_007:6.en:
$$桂$$
「I've heard from AG that you're Miss $$スズネ$$'s hidden personality.」

438:t_007:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...So that one has gone over to your side. Well, it's only natural.」

438:t_007:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of talking with you. We'll be your opponents in place of $n.」

438:t_007:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Oh? He's absent... Heh... What a pity, this.」

438:t_007:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The way you talk... I take it you know $n's situation.」

438:t_007:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Using $n's absence to get your hands on the $$ジェニオン$$, is that it?」

438:t_007:12.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'm not the only one who's been waiting for an opening.」

438:t_008:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's $$ズール$$'s and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s armies!」

438:t_008:1.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「For opponents like you are now, this much will more than suffice.」

438:t_008:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「You mean you won't lose even as an avatar!?」

438:t_008:4.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「Exactly. Ahead of the great collapse that comes once every 120 million years, the power of darkness is growing stronger.」

438:t_008:5.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「If you think the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and I are the same as before, allow me to teach you how gravely mistaken you are.」

438:t_008:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ has powered up as well...!」

438:t_008:7.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Now that all the players are here, let's begin. It looks like it'll be a fun party.」

438:t_009:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「No way...! Sending him out when he hasn't even regained consciousness yet...!」

438:t_009:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「What the hell are you doing, $$クロウ$$! Are you trying to kill $n!?」

438:t_009:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It was I who asked $$クロウ$$ to send $n out if Miss $$スズネ$$ appeared.」

438:t_009:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't screw around, AG! There's no way $n can fight in this state!」

438:t_009:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n left the measures to take in an emergency entirely up to me. $n has already agreed to this as well.」

438:t_009:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「Measures!? What do you take humans for!?」

438:t_009:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Carbon compounds with a soul in them. That is all.」

438:t_009:13.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Exactly, AG. ...But what those carbon compounds produce is precisely what you are seeking, is it not?」

438:t_009:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have no intention of speaking with you. My business is with Miss $$スズネ$$.」

438:t_009:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「How unfriendly. Fine, then I'll do as I please on my end!」

438:t_010:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「You idiot, $$クロウ$$! You knew it would come to this, and you still let AG rope you into it!?」

438:t_010:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What are you saying! Did AG win you over with money!?」

438:t_010:8.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I get how determined you are! But we can't let $n get taken out!」

438:t_010:10.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What do we do!? At this rate we can't even fall back!」
